description: This PHP class defines an API endpoint for performing actions (such as submit, approve, pay, cancel, reject) on claim requests within the OrangeHRM system. It handles request validation, transaction management, and state transitions for claim requests.

classes.name: ClaimRequestActionAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for handling actions on claim requests, including state transitions and validation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles the HTTP PUT request to perform an action on a claim request, managing transaction, validation, and state change.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the update method, ensuring request ID is positive and action is valid.

methods.name: getResultingState
methods.description: Determines the new state of a claim request based on the current state and requested action.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to retrieve a single resource.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to provide validation rules for getOne.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to provide validation rules for delete.
